summary: Cross-tenant delegation token expiry after proxy rotation causes login loop for analytics portal
description:
Issue summary:
Users are unable to sign into the internal analytics portal when using cross-tenant delegated access (partner org delegation). After a scheduled proxy (terminator) rotation, delegated bearer tokens issued by Okta appear to be rejected and an immediate login loop occurs.

Impact:
- ~40 users across multiple teams report being unable to access analytics dashboards since 2026-03-12 09:30 PDT.
- Affects internal-only analytics portal behind the ingress proxy; business reporting workflows disrupted.
- No public-facing customer impact but blocks internal reports used by Sales and Ops.

Environment:
- Production (prod-us-west) environment behind the edge proxy cluster (terminators-rw-prod-us-west).
- Okta org: redwood-main; delegated partner orgs via cross-tenant trust config.

Steps to reproduce:
1. User from partner org initiates SSO via delegated link to analytics portal.
2. Okta issues delegation token and redirects through our ingress proxy.
3. During proxy certificate rotation/terminator fleet refresh (scheduled window), token validation fails on first request after rotation and browser is redirected back to Okta for auth.
4. After redirect, session cookie is set but subsequent requests see 401 from our proxy and flow repeats (login loop).

Expected behavior:
- Delegated token remains valid across proxy rotation; session continues or gracefully prompts once and accepts reauth.

Actual behavior:
- Delegated tokens are rejected with HTTP 401 at the proxy layer immediately after proxy terminator rotation. Session cookies are reissued but backend rejects requests until a manual clear of certain cookies or a full browser restart.

Temporary workaround:
- Users can clear cookies for the analytics portal domain or open an incognito window to complete sign-in. Not scalable for >30 users.

Additional notes:
- Issue first observed right after a scheduled automatic terminator certificate rotation at 09:25 PDT. Lasts for ~15–40 minutes depending on sticky session regeneration cadence.
investigation_notes:
Summary of findings to date:
- We can reproduce reliably in a staging cluster by rotating the terminator certificates and performing cross-tenant Okta flows.
- Logs show proxy returning HTTP 401 with message: "delegation-token: validation failed (token-kid-mismatch)" immediately after rotation.
- Okta's issued tokens have kid header matching old signing key for a short window; our proxy's cert/key reload path appears to evict in-memory JWK cache and fails to validate tokens that are otherwise valid according to Okta (observed mismatch between JWKs fetched and token kid).
- JIT SCIM provisioning requests also receive 401 from the token validation layer, causing users not to be provisioned which makes fallback impossible.
- No errors observed in Okta logs indicating rejected tokens on their side; they report tokens issued successfully.
- Affected flow path: edge proxy (terminator) -> auth middleware (token validation service) -> scim-provisioner -> analytics console.

Hypothesis:
- Token validation service has a race during proxy key rotation: JWK cache invalidation combined with request concurrency causes token-kid lookup to fail. The proxy rotation triggers rekeying that isn't atomically visible to the validator, so requests with tokens issued just before rotation get rejected.

Next steps planned:
- Create a canary that defers JWK cache eviction for 60s after rotation to cover Okta issuance window.
- Add detailed telemetry: log token kid, current JWK set version, and a trace id for failed auth attempts to correlate with terminator rotation events.
- Reproduce in prod canary (single terminator) during next low-impact rotation window and monitor.

Related artifacts:
- Proxy rotation timeline and metrics: https://confluence.internal.redwood/proxy/rotations#2026-03-12
- Auth validator dashboard (grafana): https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/abc123/auth-validator-overview
- Repro script: github.com/redwood-inference/ops/playbooks/okta-proxy-rotation-repro (PR pending)
